notes.title: The Announcement of the "Delivery Driver Service" game!
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear player!

We, the Arkuda inc. team, are pleased to present you the prologue of our game and hope that you will be interested in getting to know the world of the game before you start playing the full version.

We want to warn you right away that some things in the game may not work exactly as you expect, and some things may not look quite perfect. Many game mechanics are still under development, as well as the visual part of the game.

We really want you to have fun and enjoy playing our game, so we will be constantly working on improving the gameplay and visuals.

We wish you an enjoyable game and hope you will be satisfied with our game! 

Don't forget to add the game to your "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2791970/Delivery_Driver_Service/]Wishlist[/url]"!
